label: Novahiz Search
purpose: House clean-room MCP: FTS5 full-text search, symbols, call graph, repo map, git status. Zero npm dependencies (node:sqlite, node:fs, node:child_process); read-only tools, relative paths, bounded results.

label: Novahiz Scheduler
purpose: Local stdio scheduler written in this repository (zero npm dependency, own cron parser, atomic JSON store). Replaces the external mcp-cron server; no third-party scheduler code is used.

label: Novahiz Core
purpose: Novahiz stdio MCP (novahiz_providers, novahiz_deps, memory tools). The opencode plugin resolves this path from the home directory itself; edit the command for other harnesses.

label: Dart / Flutter MCP
purpose: Official Dart SDK MCP: analyzer diagnostics, symbols, test launch, runtime inspection.

label: Flutter agent skills
purpose: 25 official Flutter/Dart agent skills (layouts, tests, architecture, routing, l10n).

label: Dart agent skills
purpose: 15 official Dart skills (subset of flutter/agent-plugins, kept for provenance).

label: Expo agent skills
purpose: 19 official Expo framework skills (expo-* group); the 7 eas-* paid-service skills are excluded. Installed to ~/.agents/skills; when git clone fails, fetch the tarball from codeload.github.com and copy the skill folders.

label: Impeccable design skill
purpose: Upstream Impeccable skill (critique, audit and polish playbooks) required by gate rule R14. Installed to ~/.agents/skills; rerun the command to update.

label: Novahiz Scan
purpose: Local stdio static-analysis server (zero npm dependency): scans files and directories with local security rules (SQL injection, XSS, command injection, hardcoded secrets, insecure deserialization), creates custom rules behind a ReDoS gate, exports json/sarif/csv/html. Original clean-room implementation for the audit category.

label: Stitch fidelity capture (adb + Android emulator)

default: install Android platform-tools (adb) and the Android emulator on PATH

purpose: Prerequisite for skill novahiz-stitch-fidelity: `adb` drives the capture (uiautomator dump, screencap, input). `emulator` is only needed to auto-start a device when nothing is online (adb.autoStart); `stitch_capture.mjs --check` reports all seven readiness items.

label: novahiz-gate
purpose: Novahiz rule gate: validates an edit against the skills roadmap before it lands (allow / required / missing skills), with ledger enforcement parity with the CLI. Extracted from the novahiz-tools server.
